apps.name: Meet
apps.description: Instant 1-on-1 video meetings with push notifications. Go available, share your link, get notified when someone joins.
apps.about:
Meet is a zero-install video calling app. Toggle your availability, share a link, and get a push notification when someone joins your room. Video and audio are peer-to-peer via WebRTC — no media server, no latency, no data collection.

Designed for quick 1-on-1 calls, not large meetings. The availability toggle lets contacts see when you're free without messaging you first. Push notifications ensure you never miss a join — even if the tab is closed.

apps.name: Meetup
apps.description: Create events, groups, and real-time chat. RSVP tracking, attendee counts, and community management.
apps.about:
Meetup is a full-featured event management platform. Create public or private events with location, date/time, and capacity limits. Organize recurring groups around shared interests — book clubs, running groups, tech meetups, language exchanges.

Every event gets its own real-time chat room powered by WebSocket rooms, so attendees can coordinate before, during, and after the event. RSVP tracking shows who's coming, who's maybe, and how many spots are left.

Built for community organizers who need more than a shared calendar but less than a full social network. No ads, no algorithmic feed — just events and the people going to them.
proFeatures: Create events with date, time, location, capacity
Organize recurring groups around shared interests
RSVP tracking with live attendee counts

apps.name: Dating
apps.description: Swipe-style dating — build a profile, swipe through people nearby, and chat in real-time when you both like each other.
apps.about:
A swipe-based dating app built entirely on the ProAppStore SDK. Create a profile with photos, bio, and preferences. Browse through potential matches with swipe-left/right gestures. When two people both swipe right, a match is created and a real-time chat room opens.

Photos are stored on R2. Profile data lives in D1. The mutual-match detection uses atomic counter increments to prevent race conditions. Chat is powered by WebSocket rooms — one room per match, created on-demand.

Privacy-first: no tracking, no algorithmic manipulation, no dark patterns. Your data stays on the platform and is deleted when you delete your account.
proFeatures: Privacy-first — no tracking or data selling

apps.name: Loopride
apps.description: Recurring rides — set up a route, days and time once, and your driver shows up week after week. Live GPS tracking when the trip starts.
apps.about:
Loopride solves the problem of recurring trips — school runs, commute shares, weekly errands. Set up a route with pickup and dropoff points, choose which days and times, and your driver follows the same schedule every week.

Routes are geocoded using the platform's maps API. Driving directions render as a real route on the map (not a straight line). When a trip starts, the driver's GPS position is tracked live and shared with passengers via WebSocket rooms.

Designed for small groups who ride together regularly. Not a ride-hailing service — no surge pricing, no matching algorithms, no marketplace dynamics. Just a shared schedule for people who already know each other.
proFeatures: Set up recurring routes with days and times
Geocoded pickup/dropoff points on real maps
Live GPS tracking during trips (WebSocket rooms)

apps.name: GrassKarma
apps.description: Hyper-local lawn care — neighbours share a mower, street by street.
apps.about:
GrassKarma is a hyper-local lawn care sharing platform. Streets organize into groups. Someone in the group owns a mower and offers to cut lawns for neighbours. Karma points track who's contributing and who's receiving.

Each street group is geocoded to a real address range. Members join by entering their street address — the platform matches them to the nearest group or creates a new one. Reviews and karma scores build trust within the group.

Built on the premise that most suburban streets have 3-4 lawnmowers for 20+ houses. One shared mower, maintained by the group, cuts everyone's lawn on rotation. The app just coordinates who, when, and tracks the karma.
proFeatures: Mower discovery — who has one nearby
Push notifications for your mow day

apps.name: Kanban Pro
apps.description: Team kanban boards with real-time presence, assignees, and live collaboration.
apps.about:
Kanban Pro is a real-time collaborative kanban board. Create workspaces, invite team members via shareable links, and manage tasks across customizable columns. See who's looking at the board right now with live presence indicators.

Every action — moving a card, editing a title, assigning a member — syncs instantly across all connected browsers via WebSocket rooms. No refresh needed. Drag-and-drop cards between columns. Assign team members to cards. Add status, ETA, requirements, and acceptance criteria.

Cards support @mentions that trigger push notifications. Filter the board by assignee, status, or search text. The "Launched" column auto-caps at 10 cards with an expand toggle to keep the board fast.
proFeatures: Live presence — see who's on the board
Status, ETA, requirements, acceptance criteria per card
Board filters: assignee, status, text search

apps.name: TimeTrack
apps.description: Track time, manage projects, send invoices. Timers, day/week views, expense tracking, reports, and billing.
apps.about:
TimeTrack is a time tracking and invoicing app inspired by Harvest. Start a timer or log hours manually against any project and task combination. Switch between day view (entry list with inline editing) and week view (spreadsheet grid with daily totals).

Organize work by clients, projects, and tasks. Set billing rates at the project, task, or user level. Track budgets with visual progress bars.

Log expenses with categories (including unit-based pricing like mileage), attach receipt photos via R2 storage, and mark them billable. Create invoices from unbilled time and expenses, add tax and discounts, record payments.

Run reports by client, project, task, or team member across any date range. See total hours, billable hours, and billable amounts. Export to CSV.
proFeatures: Running timers with live elapsed display
Day view and week view (spreadsheet grid)
Projects with clients, billing rates, and budgets
Invoicing from tracked time and expenses
Reports by client, project, task, and team
Tax, discount, and payment terms on invoices

apps.name: Bandmates
apps.description: Find musicians, manage bands, discover events.
apps.about:
Bandmates helps musicians find each other. Create a profile with your instruments, genres, experience level, and location. Browse other musicians in your area. Form bands, manage rehearsal schedules, and discover local music events.

Each band gets a shared space with member management, a setlist builder, and a rehearsal calendar. Band members can chat in real-time. Event discovery shows local gigs, open mics, and jam sessions — searchable by genre, venue, and date.

Built for the musician who just moved to a new city, the drummer looking for a weekend cover band, or the singer-songwriter who wants to find a guitarist for a duo.
proFeatures: Musician profiles with instruments and genres

apps.name: Micro
apps.description: Collaborative whiteboard — infinite canvas with shapes, sticky notes, freehand drawing, and real-time sync.
apps.about:
Micro is a collaborative whiteboard inspired by Miro. An infinite SVG canvas with pan, zoom, and a full shape toolkit: rectangles, ellipses, lines, freehand drawing, text, and sticky notes.

Select, move, and resize shapes with precision handles. Undo/redo with Cmd+Z. Boards auto-save to D1 — create multiple boards, rename them, and pick up where you left off. Keyboard shortcuts for every tool make it fast to switch between drawing modes.

Built for brainstorming, wireframing, and visual collaboration. Real-time multiplayer with cursor presence is coming next.
proFeatures: Infinite SVG canvas with pan and zoom
6 drawing tools: rect, ellipse, line, freehand, text, sticky
Select, move, resize with precision handles
Board persistence — create, rename, delete boards

apps.name: Chess Academy
apps.description: Online chess teaching — real-time games with teacher oversight, Swiss tournaments, puzzle sets with scoring and hints.
apps.about:
Chess Academy is an online teaching platform built for chess schools and academies. Teachers can monitor all active games in real-time, pause and resume boards, and manage Swiss-system tournaments with automatic pairings and colour balancing.

Students play rated or unrated games with configurable time controls, solve curated puzzle sets with progressive hints, and track their Glicko-2 ratings. Puzzle sets can be imported from PGN files and assigned to individual students.

Multi-tenant by design — each academy runs as an isolated tenant with its own students, teachers, and data. Built on chessground (the Lichess board library) and chess.js for move validation, with Stockfish WASM for hints and puzzle analysis.
proFeatures: Puzzle sets with hints and scoring
Glicko-2 ratings for games and puzzles

Payment is arranged directly between the participants. Tradies does not provide checkout, payment processing or escrow.

apps.name: Stash
apps.description: Share sealed, in-date packaged goods with neighbours. Browse, order and arrange nearby collection.
apps.about:
Stash helps neighbours share sealed, in-date packaged goods. Hosts choose whether their listings are discoverable inside an invite-only pocket, in the neighbourhood, or both. Buyers browse, order and arrange collection.

Payment is arranged directly between host and buyer; Stash takes no payments. Exact host addresses are shown only to buyers with an active order.
